verdict.rationale: Fathom documents non-interactive programmatic access suited to scripts and CI jobs. Static API keys generated in User Settings authenticate all REST resources, available on all plans. Official TypeScript and Python SDKs handle pagination and automatically retry rate-limited requests. Endpoints cover meetings, transcripts, summaries, downloads and webhook creation, so meeting data can be pulled and processed headlessly. Missing for 10: a dedicated CLI or documented CI/headless mode, CI-specific guidance or examples, any way to trigger core product actions (meeting capture) headlessly, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
